# iconifyr

iconifyr is an R client for the [Iconify
API](https://iconify.design/docs/api/): 400,000+ icons from 240+
open-source sets, as SVG, inline HTML or PNG. It supports self-hosted
APIs, caches responses on disk, retries on 429/5xx, and tells you when a
license requires attribution.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("noahweidig/iconifyr")
```

## Examples

Get an icon as SVG (ids are `prefix:name`):

``` r

library(iconifyr)
svg <- iconify_get("mdi:home", color = "#ba3329", size = 48)
cat(svg)
#> <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path fill="#ba3329" d="M10 20v-6h4v6h5v-8h3L12 3L2 12h3v8z"/></svg>
```

Search across sets:

``` r

head(iconify_search("home", prefixes = c("mdi", "tabler"), limit = 40))
#>                     id prefix          name
#> 1             mdi:home    mdi          home
#> 2     mdi:home-outline    mdi  home-outline
#> 3          tabler:home tabler          home
#> 4   tabler:home-filled tabler   home-filled
#> 5        tabler:home-2 tabler        home-2
#> 6 tabler:home-2-filled tabler home-2-filled
```

Check a license before you use a set:

``` r

iconify_license("fa6-solid")
#> ! "Font Awesome 6 Solid" ("fa6-solid") is licensed "CC BY 4.0": attribution is required. Credit "Dave Gandy".
#> Font Awesome 6 Solid (fa6-solid)
#>   License:              CC BY 4.0 (CC-BY-4.0)
#>   License URL:          https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
#>   Author:               Dave Gandy
#>   Author URL:           https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome
#>   Attribution required: yes
```

Inline an icon in R Markdown, Quarto or Shiny with
[`iconify_html()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_html.md),
save files with
[`iconify_download()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_download.md),
or render a PNG with
[`iconify_png()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_png.md).
See
[`vignette("getting-started")`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/articles/getting-started.md).

## Options

| Option | Default | Purpose |
|----|----|----|
| `iconifyr.api` | `"https://api.iconify.design"` | API base URL (self-hosted APIs) |
| `iconifyr.cache` | `TRUE` | Cache responses under `tools::R_user_dir("iconifyr", "cache")` |

# Package index

## Get icons

Fetch icons as SVG, files, inline HTML or PNG.

- [`iconify_get()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_get.md)
  : Get an icon as SVG
- [`iconify_download()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_download.md)
  : Download icons as SVG files
- [`iconify_html()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_html.md)
  : Inline an icon as HTML
- [`iconify_png()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_png.md)
  : Render an icon to PNG

## Search and browse

Find icons and list icon sets.

- [`iconify_search()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_search.md)
  : Search for icons
- [`iconify_sets()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_sets.md)
  : List icon sets
- [`iconify_icons()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_icons.md)
  : List the icons in a set

## Licensing

Check licenses and attribution requirements.

- [`iconify_license()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_license.md)
  : Get license and author information

## Utilities

- [`iconify_cache_clear()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/iconifyr/reference/iconify_cache_clear.md)
  : Clear the iconifyr cache
